items.title: Charles Lloyd — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: So, and then we figured out there was a connection with him. I didn’t know what it was. It was spiritual, I felt it, and Booker and I were listening to this stuff all the time.

ctx.x: I knew this! I felt it!

So, and then we figured out there was a connection with him. I didn’t know what it was. It was spiritual, I felt it, and Booker and I were listening to this stuff all the time. And so when I got to USC... Here’s another thing: Because I got run out of town so early, and I didn’t get to go to Chicago or New York with my peers.
